entries.question: What is your return policy for electronics?
entries.answer: Our return policy allows returns within 30 days of purchase with the original receipt and original packaging. Electronics must be in resalable condition. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method. Items that have been opened must include all original accessories and documentation.

entries.question: Can I return a final-sale item?
entries.answer: Final-sale items are non-returnable under our standard policy. However, if the item arrives damaged or defective, you are eligible for a full refund or exchange regardless of the final-sale designation. Contact support within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the damage.

entries.question: How long does a refund take to appear?
entries.answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. Depending on your bank or card issuer, it may take an additional 3-5 business days to appear on your statement.

entries.question: What if I lost my receipt?
entries.answer: A receipt or proof of purchase is required for all returns. If you purchased online, your order confirmation email serves as your receipt. In-store purchases without a receipt may be eligible for store credit at the current selling price.

entries.question: How long does shipping take?
entries.answer: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping takes 2-3 business days. Delivery times may vary during peak seasons. We do not offer same-day or next-day delivery.

entries.question: Do you offer free shipping?
entries.answer: We offer free standard shipping on orders over $50. Orders under $50 are charged a flat shipping fee of $5.99. Express shipping is always charged at the standard rate regardless of order total.

entries.question: What is the warranty on electronics?
entries.answer: Electronics are covered by the manufacturer's warranty only. We do not offer extended warranties. Most electronics carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Check your product documentation for specific warranty terms.

entries.question: Can I cancel or modify my order?
entries.answer: Orders can be cancelled or modified within 1 hour of placement. After that, the order enters our fulfillment pipeline and cannot be changed. If you miss the 1-hour window, you may return the item after delivery under our standard return policy.

entries.question: What payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and store gift cards. We do not accept cash, checks, or cryptocurrency. All transactions are processed securely.

entries.question: Do you offer financing or buy-now-pay-later?
entries.answer: We offer financing through our credit partner. Monthly payment plans are available for purchases over $200. All financing is subject to credit approval. APR and terms are disclosed at checkout before you confirm the purchase.

entries.question: How do I contact customer support?
entries.answer: Our customer support team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. You can reach us by phone at 1-800-555-0100, by email at support@techmart.example.com, or via live chat on our website.

entries.question: How do I track my order?
entries.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number by email. You can use this number on our website or the carrier's website to track delivery progress in real time.

entries.question: Is my personal data secure?
entries.answer: Yes. We use industry-standard TLS encryption for all transactions. We do not store full credit card numbers. Your personal information is never sold to third parties. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

entries.question: Do you ship internationally?
entries.answer: Currently we only ship within the United States and Canada. International orders are not supported at this time. For Canadian orders, additional customs duties may apply.

entries.question: What should I do if my item arrives damaged?
entries.answer: If your item arrives damaged, contact support within 48 hours of delivery. Please provide your order number and clear photos of the damage. We will arrange a replacement or full refund at no additional cost.
